posts.name: Bowie
posts.cooked:
Well, I'd love to design up one for most heroes and some villains -- tanktop variants would work for most (my plans for Agent of Gloom Spite and Bunker require shoulders, tho), though some fit tanktops fit the designs for the heroes better than others. Tachyon and Ex-Pat basically demand tanktops, after-all.

 

Since I don't have authorization to make products with these copyrights, though, not sure how legal it is for me to do more than design them! But expect me to work some more designs up.

If there's a specific request, let me know. Otherwise, this is the order I'll probably slog through, give or take inspiration:
 

Heroes:
Tempest (long sleeve with freckled green arms) [by request]
Dark Watch Nightmist [by request]
Guise [by request]
Argent Adept
The Naturalist
Chrono-Ranger
Omnitron-X
Parse
Fanatic
Setback
The Sentinels team logo from Adamant variant
Scholar tattoos from Incap
KNYFE (variant KNYFE?)
Akash’thriya of the Void
GI Bunker details with Bunker patch on shoulder
Benchmark
DW Mr. Fixer

Villains:
Vengeance/Tactics/Luminary Blade
Wager Master
Biomancer
Gloomweaver
Proletariat
Agent of Gloom Spite
Deadline/Lifeline
Flip Apostate
Miss Information flipside
Cueball
Ambuscade (any)
Bugbear
Hammer and Anvil
VotM Operative or Tactics Operative
Professor Pollution
Heartbreaker

There’s a lot of designs that just don’t work like this in an iconic t-shirt design way that strikes me. I have a list of other ideas for 90% of the other characters that’d be good in-universe fan shirts I could see designed, like just the big telepathy icon of Visionary’s filling a shirt, so on-- but I want to try the “costume shirt” line first until I get tired of it.
